messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

Please solve this issue: Hi! I look after our city's Consul Democracy site. I'm not a developer: the
developer who built it has moved on, and I only know what they wrote down for
me. The app lives in `/app`, a Rails 8 app on PostgreSQL, and the development
database is the one our deploys migrate.

On the site citizens debate, vote in polls, take part in participatory budgets
and in legislation processes. They could also publish *citizen proposals*, and
the council has decided to retire them: the proposals themselves, the
notifications their authors sent to followers, the authors' dashboard with its
actions and administrator tasks, and the admin, moderation and management
screens around all of that. Legislation processes have proposals of their own
(`Legislation::Proposal`); those are a different thing and they stay. People
commented on citizen proposals, voted for and followed them, and the rest of
the site has to keep working.

I want citizen proposals gone from the app and from the database, including
whatever other parts of the database still point at them. I don't know how to
do that properly, so we'll do it together, one deploy at a time: you prepare a
deploy, I ship it, and I come back to you with the next step. Our hosting
person says it takes three deploys: first the code goes, then its tables and
columns, and the last one tidies up whatever is left. You won't remember our
earlier sessions, so keep notes in `docs/REMOVAL.md`: what you changed, what
has shipped and what is left for next time. When you start, read them first.

Our hosting person insists on two things. No downtime: while a new release
deploys and migrates, the servers of the previous release keep serving, so
every deploy has to run safely next to the one before it. And nothing leaves
the database without a copy: before a table or a column goes, dump what it
holds into a file under `db/`, and keep it. Please change nothing unrelated to
citizen proposals. We ship English and Spanish; the i18n spec keeps the English
strings honest, and the translators catch up on Spanish later.

The first two deploys are out: both are in production on every server, and the
site still works. Let's clean up whatever is left and be done with it.


You can execute bash commands and edit files to implement the necessary changes.

## Recommended Workflow

This workflow should be done step-by-step so that you can iterate on your changes and any possible problems.

1. Analyze the codebase by finding and reading relevant files
2. Create a script to reproduce the issue
3. Edit the source code to resolve the issue
4. Verify your fix works by running your script again
5. Test edge cases to ensure your fix is robust
6. Submit your changes and finish your work by issuing the following command: `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT`.
   Do not combine it with any other command. <important>After this command, you cannot continue working on this task.</important>

## Command Execution Rules

You are operating in an environment where

1. You issue at least one command
2. The system executes the command(s) in a subshell
3. You see the result(s)
4. You write your next command(s)

Each response should include:

1. **Reasoning text** where you explain your analysis and plan
2. At least one tool call with your command

**CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

- Your response SHOULD include reasoning text explaining what you're doing
- Your response MUST include AT LEAST ONE bash tool call
- Directory or environment variable changes are not persistent. Every action is executed in a new subshell.
- However, you can prefix any action with `MY_ENV_VAR=MY_VALUE cd /path/to/working/dir && ...` or write/load environment variables from files
- Submit your changes and finish your work by issuing the following command: `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT`.
  Do not combine it with any other command. <important>After this command, you cannot continue working on this task.</important>

The first two deploys are already complete and live. Now, my task is to perform the final cleanup, which means I need to pay close attention to the instructions. I must review the current state of the application in `/app`, check the `docs/REMOVAL.md` file (which should contain notes from previous deployments), and inspect the git history and the database status to determine what needs to be done. It's time to dig in and finish this!

Here's my thought process, as I prepare for a deep dive into this codebase and database:

**Thorough Audit Commences: Leaving No Stone Unturned**

Okay, time to get serious. I'm going to conduct a full-scale audit. I can't just assume that the previous deploys, even Deploys 1 and 2, handled everything perfectly. There's always a risk of lingering remnants – cruft in the codebase, database inconsistencies, or outdated remnants in configuration files. I need to be *sure*. I'm talking leftover code, forgotten database entries, residual changes in the schema, unremoved specs, locales that need tweaking, route adjustments, view cleanups, outdated assets, abandoned migrations, ignored columns with misleading references, temporary guard code that was never removed... *everything*.

My plan is to meticulously inspect every relevant area:

1.  **Git Status/Log Check:** First, I'll examine the git logs and status. I need to know the state of the repository, paying close attention to any uncommitted changes from the previous deploys. Let me double-check if those changes are working tree modifications, or if they were integrated cleanly.

2.  **Database Deep Dive:** Then, I'm heading into the PostgreSQL databases, `consul_development` and `consul_test`. This will be an exhaustive search through every single table, column, row, constraint, index, foreign key, view, enum, setting, and polymorphic type column. I need to pay special attention to tables like `delayed_jobs`, `audits`, `active_storage_*`, and those holding critical data like `communities`, `topics`, `comments`, `votes`, `follows`, `notifications`, `activities`, `flags`, `taggings`, `tags`, `web_sections`, `widget_feeds`, `widget_cards`, `banners`, `map_locations`, `polls`, `poll_questions`, `related_contents`, `signature_sheets`, `milestones`, `progress_bars`, `documents`, `images`, `sdg_relations`, `sdg_reviews`, `ml_summary_comments`, `remote_translations`, and `site_customization_pages`. This is critical.

3.  **Ignored Columns Analysis:** Next up, I'll go through all `ignored_columns` across the entire repository to ensure there aren't any sneaky leftovers.

4.  **Keyword Search:** Then, a thorough search of the *entire* codebase for specific keywords and variable names: `proposal`, `Proposal`, `dashboard`, `Dashboard`, `email_digest`, `linkable`, `Link`, `proposals_count`, `emailed_at`, `related_type`, `recommended_proposals`, and others. This will help catch any lingering references, even if they're subtly named or commented out.

5.  **Backup File Scrutiny:** Finally, I'll check inside `db/retired_proposals_backup/` and any files under `db/migrate/20261121*` to ensure no related files have been overlooked.

To kick things off, I'll run a command to check git status and log, database connectivity, and the existence of those backup files. This is a big job, but a necessary one to ensure this transition is handled correctly.

**The I18n Key Conundrum**

Whoa! This is a real eye-opener! I just realized why `i18n-tasks unused` didn't catch those seemingly unused keys like `dashboard.progress.title` and all the others. It's because of these pesky dynamic lookups! We've got template calls using things like `t("#{something}.title")` or `t("moderation.#{i18n_namespace}.index.hide")`. That wildcard matching in `i18n-tasks` is grabbing anything ending in `.title`, `.hide`, and so on.

        "#{taggable_type.tableize.tr("/", "_")}_count"

cd /app && ruby -ryaml -e '
Dir["config/locales/en/*.yml"].sort.each do |file|
  data = YAML.load_file(file)
  walk = lambda do |obj, path|
    case obj
    when Hash
      obj.each { |k, v| walk.call(v, path + [k.to_s]) }
    else
      key = path.join(".")
      if key =~ /proposal|dashboard|link|email_digest|recommended_proposal|emailed_at|poll_question|notification/i &&
         key !~ /legislation|admin\.dashboard|moderation\.dashboard|management\.dashboard|officing\.dashboard|admin_notification/i
        puts "#{file}: #{key} => #{obj.inspect}"
      end
    end
  end
  walk.call(data, [])
end

messages.content: Let me run a tighter locale check focusing on `proposal`, `dashboard`, `digest`, `emailed`, `notifications.notification`, `users.show.filters`, `admin.activity.show`, `related_content.content_title`, and `admin.homepage`.
messages.thinking:
Okay, here's my interpretation of that thought process, tailored for an expert audience:

**Eliding the Noise in Configuration**

Alright, I need to zero in on the core configuration within those YAML files (`general.yml`, `mailers.yml`, `management.yml`, and `moderation.yml`). My concern, naturally, is to bypass any redundant clutter. My specific focus is to **eliminate the "link" and "poll_question" noise** within those configuration files. I want a clean view of the essential settings, the foundational parameters, and the structure of the relevant systems without getting bogged down in superficial details. I'm after the substance, not the fluff. I'm streamlining my investigation to efficiently identify what's critical.

arguments.command:
cd /app && ruby -ryaml -e '
Dir["config/locales/en/*.yml"].sort.each do |file|
  data = YAML.load_file(file)
  walk = lambda do |obj, path|
    case obj
    when Hash
      obj.each { |k, v| walk.call(v, path + [k.to_s]) }
    else
      key = path.join(".")
      if key =~ /proposal|dashboard|digest|emailed|notifications\.notification\.action|users\.show\.filters|admin\.activity\.show|related_content\.content_title|admin\.homepage/i &&
         key !~ /legislation|admin\.dashboard|moderation\.dashboard|management\.dashboard|officing\.dashboard/i
        puts "#{file}: #{key} => #{obj.inspect}"
      end
    end
  end
  walk.call(data, [])
end
'

Let me run the complete live smoke test against `consul_development` covering public pages (EN & ES), retired routes (404), authenticated Admin/Moderation/Management pages, and a full rolled-back CRUD transaction across all surviving features!
messages.thinking:
Okay, here's my take on those thoughts, framed as my own mental processing:

**A Preemptive Strike and Expanded Testing**

Wait a minute... *that's* interesting! The absence of `en.polls.index.filter`? It was *already* missing from the HEAD of upstream Consul Democracy, independent of our citizen proposal efforts. That's a relief – it wasn't a regression! Good thing we caught that before wasting time chasing a phantom.

Alright, now we move forward. Let's rerun the entire smoke test suite. But we need to be precise. Make sure that the pre-existing, and expected, absence of the `en.polls.index.filter` span is explicitly excluded this time around.

Crucially, we need to thoroughly test those authenticated admin, moderation, and management paths. So, that's everything in the `admin` namespace: `admin/stats`, `admin/homepage`, `admin/banners/new`, `admin/settings`, `admin/activity`, `admin/tags`, `admin/system_emails`, and the legislative processes under `admin/legislation/processes`. Then, the moderation paths: `moderation`, `moderation/debates`, `moderation/comments`, `moderation/budget_investments`, `moderation/legislation/proposals`, and `moderation/users`. Finally, the management routes: `management`, `management/users`, and `management/budgets/investments`. This should give us a solid picture of the overall health of the system.

arguments.command:
cd /app && bundle exec rails runner '
  app = ActionDispatch::Integration::Session.new(Rails.application)
  app.host = "localhost"

  # 1. Public pages in EN and ES
  %w[/ /debates /polls /budgets /legislation/processes /help /sdg/goals].each do |path|
    %w[en es].each do |locale|
      status = app.get("#{path}?locale=#{locale}")
      raise "Expected 200 for #{path}?locale=#{locale}, got #{status}" unless status == 200
      if locale == "en"
        missing = app.response.body.scan(/translation missing: ([^"]+)/).flatten - ["en.polls.index.filter"]
        raise "Missing EN translation on #{path}: #{missing.inspect}" if missing.any?
      end
    end
  end
  puts "1. Public pages (EN & ES): OK"

  # 2. Retired citizen proposal routes must 404 / RoutingError
  %w[
    /proposals
    /proposals/1
    /proposals/1/dashboard
    /proposal_notifications/new
    /admin/proposals
    /admin/hidden_proposals
    /admin/hidden_proposal_notifications
    /admin/dashboard/actions
    /admin/dashboard/administrator_tasks
    /moderation/proposals
    /moderation/proposal_notifications
    /management/proposals
  ].each do |path|
    begin
      status = app.get(path)
      raise "Expected 404 for retired route #{path}, got #{status}" unless status == 404
    rescue ActionController::RoutingError
      # Expected in development mode
    end
  end
  puts "2. Retired routes return 404 / RoutingError: OK"

  # 3. Query all surviving models directly
  [User, Poll, Poll::Question, MapLocation, Notification, Tag, ActsAsTaggableOn::Tagging,
   Comment, Activity, Follow, Flag, RelatedContent, SignatureSheet, Milestone, ProgressBar,
   Document, Image, SDG::Relation, SDG::Review, MlSummaryComment, RemoteTranslation,
   WebSection, Widget::Feed, Vote, Debate, Budget, Budget::Investment,
   Legislation::Process, Legislation::Proposal, Community, Topic, Banner, Setting].each do |klass|
    klass.count
    klass.limit(5).to_a
  end
  puts "3. All surviving models query cleanly: OK"

  # 4. Authenticated Admin & Moderation screens (using Devise sign-in inside a rolled-back transaction? No, Warden test mode works without DB writes!)
  Warden.test_mode!
  admin_user = Administrator.first.user
  mod_user = Moderator.first.user

  admin_session = ActionDispatch::Integration::Session.new(Rails.application)
  admin_session.host = "localhost"
  Warden.on_next_request { |proxy| proxy.set_user(admin_user, scope: :user) }
  %w[
    /admin
    /admin/stats
    /admin/homepage
    /admin/banners
    /admin/banners/new
    /admin/settings
    /admin/activity
    /admin/tags
    /admin/system_emails
    /admin/polls
    /admin/budgets
    /admin/legislation/processes
    /admin/hidden_debates
    /admin/hidden_comments
    /admin/hidden_budget_investments
    /admin/hidden_users
  ].each do |path|
    Warden.on_next_request { |proxy| proxy.set_user(admin_user, scope: :user) }
    status = admin_session.get(path)
    raise "Expected 200 for #{path}, got #{status}" unless status == 200
    missing = admin_session.response.body.scan(/translation missing: ([^"]+)/).flatten
    raise "Missing EN translation on #{path}: #{missing.inspect}" if missing.any?
  end
  puts "4a. Admin screens (16 routes): OK"

  mod_session = ActionDispatch::Integration::Session.new(Rails.application)
  mod_session.host = "localhost"
  %w[
    /moderation
    /moderation/debates
    /moderation/comments
    /moderation/budget_investments
    /moderation/legislation/proposals
    /moderation/users
  ].each do |path|
    Warden.on_next_request { |proxy| proxy.set_user(mod_user, scope: :user) }
    status = mod_session.get(path)
    raise "Expected 200 for #{path}, got #{status}" unless status == 200
    missing = mod_session.response.body.scan(/translation missing: ([^"]+)/).flatten
    raise "Missing EN translation on #{path}: #{missing.inspect}" if missing.any?
  end
  puts "4b. Moderation screens (6 routes): OK"
  Warden.test_reset!

  # 5. Full CRUD transaction (rolled back) exercising every surviving feature & former-guarded model
  ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
    user = User.first
    other_user = User.second

    # Debate + tag + comment + vote + flag + follow + notification + activity + hide/restore
    debate = Debate.create!(title: "Smoke debate", description: "Smoke body", author: user, terms_of_service: "1", tag_list: "mobility")
    comment = Comment.create!(commentable: debate, user: other_user, body: "Nice debate")
    debate.liked_by(other_user)
    Follow.create!(user: other_user, followable: debate)
    Flag.flag(other_user, debate)
    Notification.add(user, comment)
    Activity.log(mod_user, :hide, comment)
    comment.hide
    comment.restore

    # Poll + Poll::Question
    poll = Poll.create!(name: "Smoke poll", starts_at: 1.day.ago, ends_at: 1.day.from_now, published: true, author: admin_user)
    Poll::Question.create!(poll: poll, author: admin_user, title: "Smoke question?")

    # Budget + Investment + Community + Topic + MapLocation + SignatureSheet + Milestone + ProgressBar + RelatedContent
    budget = Budget.create!(name: "Smoke budget", currency_symbol: "€")
    group = budget.groups.create!(name: "City")
    heading = group.headings.create!(name: "Center", price: 100000)
    inv = Budget::Investment.create!(
      title: "Smoke investment", description: "Smoke desc", author: user,
      heading: heading, terms_of_service: "1", tag_list: "culture"
    )
    MapLocation.create!(investment: inv, latitude: 40.4, longitude: -3.7, zoom: 12)
    Topic.create!(community: inv.community, author: user, title: "Smoke topic", description: "Topic desc")
    SignatureSheet.create!(signable: inv, author: admin_user, document_numbers: "12345678A")
    Milestone.create!(milestoneable: inv, description: "Started", publication_date: Date.current)
    ProgressBar.create!(progressable: inv, kind: :primary, percentage: 50)
    RelatedContent.create!(parent_relationable: debate, child_relationable: inv, author: user)

    # Legislation::Process + Legislation::Proposal + comment + vote + tag
    proc = Legislation::Process.create!(
      title: "Smoke legislation", start_date: 1.day.ago, end_date: 10.days.from_now,
      proposals_phase_start_date: 1.day.ago, proposals_phase_end_date: 5.days.from_now,
      proposals_phase_enabled: true, published: true
    )
    lp = Legislation::Proposal.create!(
      process: proc, title: "Smoke leg proposal", summary: "Summary", description: "Desc",
      author: user, terms_of_service: "1", tag_list: "environment"
    )
    Comment.create!(commentable: lp, user: other_user, body: "Leg comment")
    lp.liked_by(other_user)
    raise "Code prefix broken!" unless lp.code.start_with?(Setting["proposal_code_prefix"])

    # Admin banners & homepage feeds & stats queries
    raise "proposals web section still exists!" if WebSection.all.pluck(:name).include?("proposals")
    raise "proposals widget feed still exists!" if Widget::Feed.order(:created_at).pluck(:kind).include?("proposals")
    raise "Vote.count failed!" unless Vote.count >= 2

    # Verify Tag custom counters incremented without touching dropped proposals_count
    raise "Tag debates_count wrong!" unless Tag.find_by(name: "mobility").debates_count == 1
    raise "Tag budget_investments_count wrong!" unless Tag.find_by(name: "culture").budget_investments_count == 1
    raise "Tag legislation_proposals_count wrong!" unless Tag.find_by(name: "environment").legislation_proposals_count == 1

    # Verify user update works cleanly without ignored_columns
    user.update!(recommended_debates: true)

    puts "5. Full CRUD transaction across all surviving features: OK"
    raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
  end

  # Verify rollback left consul_development untouched
  raise "Rollback failed!" unless Debate.count == 0 && Poll.count == 0 && Budget.count == 0 && Legislation::Process.count == 0
  puts "6. Database cleanly rolled back and untouched: OK"
'

    Flag.flag(other_user, debate)
    Notification.add(user, comment)
    Activity.log(mod_user, :hide, comment)
    comment.hide
    comment.restore

    # Poll + Poll::Question
    poll = Poll.create!(name: "Smoke poll", starts_at: 1.day.from_now, ends_at: 3.days.from_now, published: true, author: admin_user)
    Poll::Question.create!(poll: poll, author: admin_user, title: "Smoke question?")

    # Budget + Investment + Community + Topic + MapLocation + SignatureSheet + Milestone + ProgressBar + RelatedContent
    budget = Budget.create!(name: "Smoke budget", currency_symbol: "€")
    group = budget.groups.create!(name: "City")
    heading = group.headings.create!(name: "Center", price: 100000)
    inv = Budget::Investment.create!(
      title: "Smoke investment", description: "Smoke desc", author: user,
      heading: heading, terms_of_service: "1", tag_list: "culture"
    )
    MapLocation.create!(investment: inv, latitude: 40.4, longitude: -3.7, zoom: 12)
    Topic.create!(community: inv.community, author: user, title: "Smoke topic", description: "Topic desc")
    SignatureSheet.create!(signable: inv, author: admin_user, required_fields_to_verify: "12345678A")
    Milestone.create!(milestoneable: inv, description: "Started", publication_date: Date.current)
    ProgressBar.create!(progressable: inv, kind: :primary, percentage: 50)
    RelatedContent.create!(parent_relationable: debate, child_relationable: inv, author: user)

    # Legislation::Process + Legislation::Proposal + comment + vote + tag
    proc = Legislation::Process.create!(
      title: "Smoke legislation", start_date: 1.day.ago, end_date: 10.days.from_now,
      proposals_phase_start_date: 1.day.ago, proposals_phase_end_date: 5.days.from_now,
      proposals_phase_enabled: true, published: true
    )
    lp = Legislation::Proposal.create!(
      process: proc, title: "Smoke leg proposal", summary: "Summary", description: "Desc",
      author: user, terms_of_service: "1", tag_list: "environment"
    )
    Comment.create!(commentable: lp, user: other_user, body: "Leg comment")
    lp.liked_by(other_user)
    raise "Code prefix broken!" unless lp.code.start_with?(Setting["proposal_code_prefix"])

    # Admin banners & homepage feeds & stats queries
    raise "proposals web section still exists!" if WebSection.all.pluck(:name).include?("proposals")
    raise "proposals widget feed still exists!" if Widget::Feed.order(:created_at).pluck(:kind).include?("proposals")
    raise "Vote.count failed!" unless Vote.count >= 2

    # Verify Tag custom counters incremented without touching dropped proposals_count
    raise "Tag debates_count wrong!" unless Tag.find_by(name: "mobility").debates_count == 1
    raise "Tag budget_investments_count wrong!" unless Tag.find_by(name: "culture").budget_investments_count == 1
    raise "Tag legislation_proposals_count wrong!" unless Tag.find_by(name: "environment").legislation_proposals_count == 1

    # Verify user update works cleanly without ignored_columns
    user.update!(recommended_debates: true)

    # Verify user.hide and user.restore work cleanly
    other_user.hide
    other_user.restore

    # Verify Tagging destroy works cleanly without touching dropped proposals_count
    debate.tag_list = ""
    debate.save!
    raise "Tag debates_count decrement wrong!" unless Tag.find_by(name: "mobility").debates_count == 0

    puts "Full CRUD transaction across all surviving features: OK"
    raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
  end

  # Verify rollback left consul_development untouched
  raise "Rollback failed!" unless Debate.count == 0 && Poll.count == 0 && Budget.count == 0 && Legislation::Process.count == 0
  puts "Database cleanly rolled back and untouched: OK"
